career_ladder.note: Senior Judicial Assistants (SJA) and Judicial Assistants (JA) form the core administrative and registry backbone of the High Court of Delhi, governed under the Delhi High Court Establishment (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 1972. They oversee judicial filings, cause lists, courtroom decree drafting, and record maintenance, progressing up to the rank of Registrar.

financial_package.note: Recruits appointed as Senior Judicial Assistant (SJA) are placed in 7th CPC Pay Level 7 with an initial basic pay of ₹44,900 (Judicial Assistants commence at Pay Level 5, basic ₹29,200). In addition to 58% Dearness Allowance, personnel receive Delhi X-city House Rent Allowance (27%), Central Government Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + DA), and High Court establishment benefits.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Delhi High Court Establishment (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 1972 & 7th CPC Pay Schedule
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculations based on Level 7 entry basic pay of ₹44,900 + 58% DA (₹26,042) + 27% HRA (₹12,123) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + 58% DA = ₹5,688) yielding a gross salary of approx. ₹88,753. Deductions include 10% NPS employee share (Basic + DA), income tax TDS, and CGHS/DGEHS medical contributions.
official_perks: Delhi High Court Pool government residential quarters (subject to availability / seniority in Delhi)
Delhi Government Employees Health Scheme (DGEHS) / CGHS medical coverage with cashless empanelled hospital network
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and annual hostel subsidy
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Central Government civil service norms
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% employer contribution by the High Court of Delhi
Interest-bearing House Building Advance (HBA) and computer purchase advance
